verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can destroy, cure, or prevent the coronavirus. Health organizations and fact-checkers have widely debunked this claim.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming consensus of evidence from multiple TIER_1 fact-checkers (Associated Press, AFP, BOOM Fact Check, Alt News) and health organizations contradicts the claim. They state there is no scientific basis for the idea that drinking hot water with lemon can destroy the coronavirus or prevent COVID-19. The UK government has referred to such claims as "dangerous quack cures."
